scope: Diagnostic of the 41 historical eligible PMLB folds and separately the already inspected Optdigits official holdout. The archived half-anchor candidate slates, Gain and voting decisions and the outcome definitions are fixed. Earlier work scored outer predictions only for final selected supports. This analysis refits every support on the half-width slate.
unit: Within fold use every unique original candidate and the original anchor. Train separate guard models on fitting plus proposal rows, and separate final models on all development rows. Reproduce every available previous guard or final probability vector exactly. Candidate outcomes never select a deployed policy.
question: For each original fixed-width nomination, decompose unrealized compression: no candidate passes the outer test; outer-eligible candidates exist but none passes the guard; both tests pass for at least one candidate but the nominee does not pass both. Evaluate exact equality with the nominal deletion fraction. At singleton anchors the nominal and all component fractions are zero.
guard: The original archived 3% joint AUC/accuracy loss allowance on guard data remains fixed. Use an additional 5% AP threshold wherever the original rare-positive rule applied.
outer: Primary original 3% joint tolerance, descriptive sensitivity using 1% and 5% outer AUC/accuracy only while holding the guard rule and nominations fixed. PMLB and Optdigits reported independently; hindsight availability is conditional on sampled support pools and measured outer outcomes.
estimands: Primary means weight each dataset equally and each eligible fold within dataset equally. Give absolute fold counts for each disjoint disposition, primary U, hindsight ceilings with/without guard and paired whole-task bootstrap intervals 30000 draws, seed 33119. Report all candidates including those never originally nominated. The oracle can use future labels and its wall time and performance are not deployable baselines.
